items.prompt: What does std::move(fixed) do to a const int fixed?

options.text: Removes const so every mutating operation is allowed

options.why: The cast does not destroy the object.

options.text: Copies its bytes into a new permanent allocation
options.why: The cast does not allocate or transfer by itself.

options.text: Forms a const-qualified xvalue for overload resolution
options.why: The available const int& can bind it, while int&& cannot.

items.explanation: The next operation chooses a matching overload; std::move is not a guarantee that a resource move occurs.
